**Is this specific to your church, or generally useful?**
Since forks are meant to stay easily upgradable (see
[UPGRADING.md](../../UPGRADING.md)), features that are church-specific
one-offs are usually better kept as a local customization in your fork,
while anything another church would plausibly also want is a great
candidate to contribute back.
